title: Stealthy point processes and lattice induction
summary: We prove a realization theorem for stealthy point processes based on lattice induction, together with a converse in dimension one. Every probability-preserving $\mathbb R^d$-action induced from a full-rank lattice admits a generating Delone cross-section whose Bartlett spectrum vanishes on a neighborhood of the origin. The construction can be chosen so that first-order linear statistics detect a nonzero part of the inducing spectral type.
